description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.
While casting Basic Attack Stage 3, hold Normal Attack to deploy Focus Ring. A cursor will move around the Focus Ring.
- Releasing the Normal Attack button when the cursor falls outside of Perfect Focus will trigger Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Trace.
- Releasing the Normal Attack button when the cursor falls within Perfect Focus will trigger Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable, dealing increased Glacio DMG and restoring additional Trace.
Pressing Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack Stage 2 will trigger Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable instead of deploying Focus Ring.
When Focus Ring is deployed, the Perfect Focus zone continues to fill the ring. Once Focus Ring is completely filled, it automatically collapses and triggers Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable.
Hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 1, 2, and 3 in sequence, and deploy Focus Ring during Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG. Shortly after performing this attack, press Normal Attack to perform Basic Attack Stage 3.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun, memberikan Glacio DMG.
Saat melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 3, tahan Normal Attack untuk memasang Focus Ring. Sebuah kursor akan bergerak mengelilingi Focus Ring.
- Melepas tombol Normal Attack saat kursor berada di luar Perfect Focus akan memicu Basic Attack Tahap 3 - Unremarkable, memberikan Glacio DMG dan memulihkan Trace.
- Melepas tombol Normal Attack saat kursor berada di dalam Perfect Focus akan memicu Basic Attack Tahap 3 - Commendable, memberikan Glacio DMG yang meningkat dan memulihkan Trace tambahan.
Menekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2 akan memicu Basic Attack Tahap 3 - Unremarkable alih-alih memasang Focus Ring.
Saat Focus Ring terpasang, zona Perfect Focus terus mengisi cincin. Setelah Focus Ring terisi penuh, cincin otomatis menyusut dan memicu Basic Attack Tahap 3 - Commendable.
Tahan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 1, 2, dan 3 secara berurutan, dan pasang Focus Ring selama Basic Attack Tahap 3.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Glacio DMG. Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG. Sesaat setelah melakukan serangan ini, tekan Normal Attack untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 3.

description.en:
Pull in nearby targets, dealing Glacio DMG.
While casting this skill, hold Resonance Skill to deploy Focus Ring. A cursor will move around the Focus Ring.
- Releasing the Resonance Skill button when the cursor falls outside of Perfect Focus will trigger Compensate, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Trace.
- Releasing the Resonance Skill button when the cursor falls within Perfect Focus will trigger Spotlight, dealing increased Glacio DMG and restoring additional Trace.
If Lucilla casts the skill on-field without holding Resonance Skill, she directly casts Compensate instead of deploying Focus Ring.

Compensate

Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and reducing the Cooldown of Lucilla's Resonance Skill by 8s.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Spotlight

Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
While casting Spotlight, Lucilla additionally restores 20 points of Concerto Energy, and inflicts 1 extra stacks of Glacio Chafe onto the target if she is in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe.
Spotlight is immune to interruptions. Switching to another Resonator while casting Spotlight ends the skill early.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
description.id:
Menarik target di sekitar, memberikan Glacio DMG.
Saat melancarkan skill ini, tahan Resonance Skill untuk memasang Focus Ring. Sebuah kursor akan bergerak mengelilingi Focus Ring.
- Melepas tombol Resonance Skill saat kursor berada di luar Perfect Focus akan memicu Compensate, memberikan Glacio DMG dan memulihkan Trace.
- Melepas tombol Resonance Skill saat kursor berada di dalam Perfect Focus akan memicu Spotlight, memberikan Glacio DMG yang meningkat dan memulihkan Trace tambahan.
Jika Lucilla melancarkan skill saat di lapangan tanpa menahan Resonance Skill, ia langsung melancarkan Compensate alih-alih memasang Focus Ring.

Compensate

Menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG dan mengurangi Cooldown Resonance Skill Lucilla sebesar 8 dtk.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Spotlight

Menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG.
Saat melancarkan Spotlight, Lucilla juga memulihkan 20 poin Concerto Energy, dan menimpakan 1 stack Glacio Chafe tambahan pada target jika ia berada dalam Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe.
Spotlight kebal terhadap interupsi. Berganti ke Resonator lain saat melancarkan Spotlight mengakhiri skill lebih awal.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

description.en:
Lucilla holds up to 0 Resonance Energy. Clear As Day consumes no Resonance Energy.
Clear As Day unlocks when Lucilla holds all 3 Photos.

Clear As Day

Deal Glacio DMG and enter Reminiscence:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, the DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG. Casting this skill grants Lucilla 30% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 10s.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, the DMG dealt is considered Echo Skill DMG. Casting this skill grants Lucilla 30% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 10s.
When in Reminiscence, Lucilla's resistance to interruption is increased, and she cannot cast Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation. Her Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Mid-air Attack, and Intro Skill - Clip It are replaced with Basic Attack - Tracing Forms, Dodge Counter - Reminiscence, Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence, and Intro Skill - Clip It: Hard Cut respectively.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

Basic Attack - Tracing Forms

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 1, 2, & 3 consecutively.
While casting Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3, consecutively press or hold Normal Attack to continuously attack the target.
While casting Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3, release the Normal Attack button or finish the whole Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3 to automatically perform Letting It Go.

Letting It Go

Deal Glacio DMG to targets within the range. When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe/Resonance Mode - Echo, DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG/Echo Skill DMG.
Lucilla is immune to interruption and damage during Letting It Go, and Resonator switching is disabled while casting.
While casting Letting It Go, Lucilla additionally restores 20 points of Concerto Energy.
Casting Letting It Go ends Reminiscence.

Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Reminiscence

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3.
description.id:
Lucilla dapat menyimpan hingga 0 Resonance Energy. Clear As Day tidak mengonsumsi Resonance Energy.
Clear As Day terbuka saat Lucilla memiliki seluruh 3 Photos.

Clear As Day

Memberikan Glacio DMG dan memasuki Reminiscence:
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, DMG yang diberikan dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG. Melancarkan skill ini memberi Lucilla 30% Basic Attack DMG Bonus selama 10 dtk.
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Echo, DMG yang diberikan dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG. Melancarkan skill ini memberi Lucilla 30% Echo Skill DMG Bonus selama 10 dtk.
Saat dalam Reminiscence, ketahanan Lucilla terhadap interupsi meningkat, dan ia tidak dapat melancarkan Resonance Skill dan Resonance Liberation. Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Mid-air Attack, dan Intro Skill - Clip It miliknya masing-masing digantikan oleh Basic Attack - Tracing Forms, Dodge Counter - Reminiscence, Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence, dan Intro Skill - Clip It: Hard Cut.
Dapat dilakukan di udara dekat tanah.

Basic Attack - Tracing Forms

Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun, memberikan Glacio DMG, dianggap Basic Attack DMG.
Tahan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Tahap 1, 2, & 3 secara beruntun.
Saat melancarkan Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Tahap 3, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack secara beruntun untuk terus menyerang target.
Saat melancarkan Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Tahap 3, lepas tombol Normal Attack atau selesaikan seluruh Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Tahap 3 untuk otomatis melakukan Letting It Go.

Letting It Go

Memberikan Glacio DMG ke target dalam jangkauan. Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe/Resonance Mode - Echo, DMG yang diberikan dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG/Echo Skill DMG.
Lucilla kebal terhadap interupsi dan damage selama Letting It Go, dan pergantian Resonator dinonaktifkan saat melancarkan.
Saat melancarkan Letting It Go, Lucilla juga memulihkan 20 poin Concerto Energy.
Melancarkan Letting It Go mengakhiri Reminiscence.

Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Glacio DMG, dianggap Basic Attack DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Tahap 2.

Dodge Counter - Reminiscence

Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG, dianggap Basic Attack DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Tahap 3.

description.en:
When Focus Ring is deployed, Lucilla slows targets within her shot.
While casting Resonance Skill - Spotlight, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her Resonance Mode:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Glacio RES of targets within a certain range around the active Resonator is reduced by 8% for 30s. If an enemy falls to Glacio Chafe DMG during this time, it counts as caused by the nearest active Resonator.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, Resonators in the team gain 25% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 30s.
These enhancements end when Lucilla switches the Resonance Mode.
description.id:
Saat Focus Ring terpasang, Lucilla memperlambat target dalam jangkauan tembakannya.
Saat melancarkan Resonance Skill - Spotlight, Lucilla memberikan peningkatan berikut berdasarkan Resonance Mode-nya:
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Glacio RES target dalam jangkauan tertentu di sekitar Resonator aktif berkurang 8% selama 30 dtk. Jika musuh tumbang oleh Glacio Chafe DMG selama waktu ini, dihitung sebagai disebabkan oleh Resonator aktif terdekat.
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Echo, Resonator di tim mendapat 25% Echo Skill DMG Bonus selama 30 dtk.
Peningkatan ini berakhir saat Lucilla mengganti Resonance Mode.

description.en:
Film Roll can now be stacked up to 10 stacks, and Zoom up to 4 stacks.
Each time Lucilla consumes Photo when in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe/Resonance Mode - Echo, she gains 2 stacks of Film Roll/1 stacks of Zoom.
description.id:
Film Roll kini dapat ditumpuk hingga 10 stack, dan Zoom hingga 4 stack.
Setiap kali Lucilla mengonsumsi Photo saat dalam Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe/Resonance Mode - Echo, ia mendapat 2 stack Film Roll/1 stack Zoom.

description.en:
Clip It

Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and inflicting 1 stacks of Glacio Chafe.

Clip It: Hard Cut

When in Reminiscence, Intro Skill is replaced with Clip It: Hard Cut.
Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and inflicting 1 stacks of Glacio Chafe.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3.
description.id:
Clip It

Menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG dan menimpakan 1 stack Glacio Chafe.

Clip It: Hard Cut

Saat dalam Reminiscence, Intro Skill digantikan oleh Clip It: Hard Cut.
Menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG dan menimpakan 1 stack Glacio Chafe.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Tahap 3.

attributes.name: Clip It: Hard Cut Concerto Regen

description.en:
Déjà Vu

While casting Resonance Liberation - Clear As Day, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her Resonance Mode:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, gain 4 stacks of Film Roll for 30s, stacking up to 4 times. All stacks are removed when the duration ends.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, gain 1 stacks of Zoom for 30s. Max 1 stack, which is removed when the duration ends.
The above effects end early when Lucilla switches Resonance Mode.

Film Roll

When an active Resonator in the team other than Lucilla inflicts Glacio Chafe onto the target, Lucilla consumes 1 stacks of Film Roll to inflict Glacio Chafe 2 times on nearby targets. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

Zoom

Each stack of Zoom increases the Crit. DMG of the active Resonator's Echo Skill by 10%.

Oblivion

During Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3, Lucilla consumes 1 Photo intermittently to perform Oblivion, dealing 1 instance of Glacio DMG:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, this instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG. The skill inflicts 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on the target.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, this instance of DMG is considered Echo Skill DMG. Each cast of Oblivion is considered as casting a different Echo Skill.

Quick Glance

Press Aim to enter the camera mode. During this mode, Reverberations, environmental collectibles, and special collectibles within a certain range of Lucilla's shot will be marked. Press the shutter button to capture the moment, and the marked items will be gathered.

Trace

Lucilla can hold up to 150 points of Trace.
Restore 100 points of Trace while casting Intro Skill - Clip It.
Restore 50 points of Trace while casting Resonance Skill - Spotlight.
Restore 50 points of Trace while casting Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable.
Restore 25 points of Trace while casting Resonance Skill - Compensate or Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable.

Photos

Lucilla can hold up to 3 Photos.
Every 50 points of Trace restored generates 1 Photo.
description.id:
Déjà Vu

Saat melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Clear As Day, Lucilla memberikan peningkatan berikut berdasarkan Resonance Mode-nya:
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, mendapat 4 stack Film Roll selama 30 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 4 kali. Semua stack dihapus saat durasi berakhir.
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Echo, mendapat 1 stack Zoom selama 30 dtk. Maksimum 1 stack, yang dihapus saat durasi berakhir.
Efek di atas berakhir lebih awal saat Lucilla mengganti Resonance Mode.

Film Roll

Saat Resonator aktif di tim selain Lucilla menimpakan Glacio Chafe pada target, Lucilla mengonsumsi 1 stack Film Roll untuk menimpakan Glacio Chafe sebanyak 2 kali pada target di sekitar. Efek ini dapat aktif sekali setiap 0,5 dtk.

Zoom

Setiap stack Zoom meningkatkan Crit. DMG Echo Skill Resonator aktif sebesar 10%.

Oblivion

Selama Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Tahap 3, Lucilla mengonsumsi 1 Photo secara berkala untuk melakukan Oblivion, memberikan 1 instance Glacio DMG:
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, DMG ini dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG. Skill ini menimpakan 1 stack Glacio Chafe pada target.
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Echo, DMG ini dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG. Setiap Oblivion yang dilancarkan dianggap sebagai Echo Skill yang berbeda.

Quick Glance

Tekan Aim untuk memasuki mode kamera. Selama mode ini, Reverberations, benda koleksi lingkungan, dan benda koleksi khusus dalam jangkauan tertentu dari bidikan Lucilla akan ditandai. Tekan tombol rana untuk mengabadikan momen, dan benda yang ditandai akan dikumpulkan.

Trace

Lucilla dapat menyimpan hingga 150 poin Trace.
Memulihkan 100 poin Trace saat melancarkan Intro Skill - Clip It.
Memulihkan 50 poin Trace saat melancarkan Resonance Skill - Spotlight.
Memulihkan 50 poin Trace saat melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 3 - Commendable.
Memulihkan 25 poin Trace saat melancarkan Resonance Skill - Compensate atau Basic Attack Tahap 3 - Unremarkable.

Photos

Lucilla dapat menyimpan hingga 3 Photos.
Setiap 50 poin Trace yang dipulihkan menghasilkan 1 Photo.

description.en:
When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Glacio Chafe DMG against targets within a certain range around the active Resonator is Amplified by 60% for 30s.
This effect ends when Lucilla switches Resonance Modes.

When in Resonance Mode - Echo, grant 50% Echo Skill DMG Amplification to the incoming Resonator for 14s.
This effect ends when the incoming Resonator is switched off the field or when Lucilla switches Resonance Modes.
description.id:
Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Glacio Chafe DMG terhadap target dalam jangkauan tertentu di sekitar Resonator aktif mendapat Amplify sebesar 60% selama 30 dtk.
Efek ini berakhir saat Lucilla mengganti Resonance Mode.

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Echo, memberikan 50% Amplify Echo Skill DMG kepada Resonator yang masuk selama 14 dtk.
Efek ini berakhir saat Resonator yang masuk diganti keluar dari lapangan atau saat Lucilla mengganti Resonance Mode.

description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en:
While casting Resonance Skill - Phantom Frame to deploy Focus Ring, the first time landing the cursor within Perfect Focus will immediately expand Perfect Focus to fill up Focus Ring.
Lucilla's Crit. Rate increases by 20% for 10s when Resonance Skill - Spotlight is cast.
Lucilla is immune to interruptions while casting Resonance Skill - Phantom Frame and Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3.
description.id:
Saat melancarkan Resonance Skill - Phantom Frame untuk memasang Focus Ring, pertama kali kursor mendarat di dalam Perfect Focus akan langsung memperluas Perfect Focus hingga memenuhi Focus Ring.
Crit. Rate Lucilla meningkat sebesar 20% selama 10 dtk saat Resonance Skill - Spotlight dilancarkan.
Lucilla kebal terhadap interupsi saat melancarkan Resonance Skill - Phantom Frame dan Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Tahap 3.

description.en:
While casting Resonance Liberation - Clear As Day, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her Resonance Mode:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Glacio Chafe DMG against targets within a certain range around the active Resonator is Amplified by 80%.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, grant 40% Echo Skill DMG Bonus to Resonators in the team.
These enhancements last as long as Reminiscence is active and remain effective for 30s after Reminiscence ends.
These effects end when Lucilla switches Resonance Modes.
description.id:
Saat melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Clear As Day, Lucilla memberikan peningkatan berikut berdasarkan Resonance Mode-nya:
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Glacio Chafe DMG terhadap target dalam jangkauan tertentu di sekitar Resonator aktif mendapat Amplify sebesar 80%.
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Echo, memberikan 40% Echo Skill DMG Bonus kepada Resonator di tim.
Peningkatan ini bertahan selama Reminiscence aktif dan tetap berlaku selama 30 dtk setelah Reminiscence berakhir.
Efek ini berakhir saat Lucilla mengganti Resonance Mode.

description.en:
Oblivion pulls in nearby targets on hit. While casting Oblivion, Lucilla's ATK is increased by 10% for 6s, stacking up 3 times. All stacks are removed when the duration ends.

description.id:
Oblivion menarik target di sekitar saat mengenai. Saat melancarkan Oblivion, ATK Lucilla meningkat sebesar 10% selama 6 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 3 kali. Semua stack dihapus saat durasi berakhir.
Saat melancarkan Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Tahap 3, Lucilla menerima 30% lebih sedikit DMG.

description.en: The DMG Multiplier of Oblivion is increased by 50%.

sequences.name: Gazing In the Mist of Time

description.en:
When in Reminiscence, each time Lucilla consumes Photo, she gains 1 stacks of Remembrance, stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of Remembrance increases Letting It Go's DMG dealt to the target by 200%, up to 600%. Casting Letting It Go removes all stacks of Remembrance.
Lucilla gains Longing if she has defeated a target while in Reminiscence: Upon ending Reminiscence while not in combat, consume Longing to restore 150 points of Trace.
description.id:
Saat dalam Reminiscence, setiap kali Lucilla mengonsumsi Photo, ia mendapat 1 stack Remembrance, bertumpuk hingga 3 kali. Setiap stack Remembrance meningkatkan DMG Letting It Go yang diberikan ke target sebesar 200%, hingga 600%. Melancarkan Letting It Go menghapus semua stack Remembrance.
Lucilla mendapat Longing jika ia telah mengalahkan target saat dalam Reminiscence: Saat mengakhiri Reminiscence di luar pertempuran, konsumsi Longing untuk memulihkan 150 poin Trace.
